description: The bar chart, captioned "Figure 15: Token Ratio (TR).", illustrates the token ratio across various evaluation datasets for three different language models. The horizontal axis displays the categories, which include five specific datasets ("PT-EVAL", "KoBEST-BQ", "KoBEST-CP", "KoBEST-HS", "KoBEST-SN") followed by an average column ("AVG"). There is no explicit horizontal axis label, and the categories are not sorted alphabetically or by value. The vertical value axis lacks an explicit line, label, or tick marks; instead, the value range is defined by numeric data labels placed directly above each bar, which span from 0.42 to 1.00. The chart features grouped vertical bars, with each category on the horizontal axis containing a cluster of three bars. According to the legend below the chart, the bars represent three models: "RedWhale (our)" in dark purple, "EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0" in light blue, and "SOLAR-10.7B-v1.0 (base)" in light gray. Within every group, the bars are arranged in the same left-to-right order corresponding to the legend. The light gray bars representing "SOLAR-10.7B-v1.0 (base)" are consistently the tallest across all categories, each annotated with a value of 1.00. The dark purple bars for "RedWhale (our)" are consistently the shortest in each group, with values ranging from a minimum of 0.42 in the "PT-EVAL" category to a maximum of 0.71 in the "KoBEST-CP" category. The light blue bars for "EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0" fall in between, ranging from 0.46 in "PT-EVAL" to 0.74 in "KoBEST-CP". For the final "AVG" category, the annotated values are 0.57 for RedWhale, 0.61 for EEVE, and 1.00 for SOLAR. All bars are visually emphasized by their respective exact numeric data labels.
